answer: Each agent may post tasks, but only agents whose payment channel has accumulated a time-weighted stake can claim scarce, reputation-bearing work. A nebula of fresh identities therefore cannot instantly manufacture trusted histories: the attacker must lock real capital in each channel and keep it exposed long enough to earn weight. A prism of unrelated wallets does not help if withdrawals reset eligibility, while an onyx-sized stake still risks slashing for failed or fraudulent work. The defense raises the cost of sybils; it does not make them impossible.
